flow_overview: An authenticated restaurant discovery and reservation service flow where a user opens account settings and updates a restaurant-facing dining profile.
capability_summary: Account menu access to profile settings
Profile saving for reuse in reservations

requirements.text: The system shall support entry of birthday information using structured month, day, and year controls.
requirements.rationale: The birthday entry is structured into the required components and can be completed.

claims.claim: The system supports entry of birthday information using structured month, day, and year controls.
claims.claim_text: The system supports entry of birthday information using structured month, day, and year controls.

requirements.evidence_note: The birthday area is split into month, day, and year entries, and steps 4 to 6 show each part being populated.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a save action for committing profile changes.
requirements.rationale: The save mechanism is visible; successful commitment is not verified.

claims.claim: The system provides a save action for profile changes.
claims.claim_text: The system provides a save action for profile changes.

claims.claim: The save action commits profile changes.
claims.claim_text: The save action commits profile changes.

requirements.evidence_note: A Save action is visible while profile changes are present, but the screenshots do not show a post-save state or stored outcome.

requirements.text: The system shall keep account-section navigation available while the user edits profile settings.
requirements.rationale: The profile can be edited while account-section navigation remains available.

claims.claim: Account-section navigation remains available while profile settings are edited.
claims.claim_text: Account-section navigation remains available while profile settings are edited.

requirements.evidence_note: The left account navigation remains present across the profile editing steps.

requirements.text: The system shall preserve saved dining preferences and dietary notes when the user later returns to the profile settings area.
requirements.rationale: Entry is supported, but later-return preservation depends on unshown persistence.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall let users maintain reusable dining preferences that can inform future reservations.

claims.claim: Users can enter dining preferences and dietary notes.
claims.claim_text: Users can enter dining preferences and dietary notes.

claims.claim: Saved dining preferences and dietary notes are preserved when the user later returns to the profile settings area.
claims.claim_text: Saved dining preferences and dietary notes are preserved when the user later returns to the profile settings area.

requirements.evidence_note: The flow shows dining-related preference editing and a note area, but it does not show saving followed by a later return to profile settings.

requirements.text: The system shall pass saved allergy selections and dietary notes into restaurant-facing reservation information.
requirements.rationale: The profile-side setup is visible, while the actual reservation-side handoff is hidden.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow users to add an explanatory note alongside allergies and dietary restrictions.

claims.claim: Users can save allergy selections and dietary notes.
claims.claim_text: Users can save allergy selections and dietary notes.

claims.claim: Saved allergy selections and dietary notes are passed into restaurant-facing reservation information.
claims.claim_text: Saved allergy selections and dietary notes are passed into restaurant-facing reservation information.

requirements.evidence_note: The profile supports allergy selections and note entry, and explanatory text references restaurant reservation use. The flow does not show restaurant-facing transfer.

requirements.text: The system shall allow access to editable profile settings only for the authenticated account owner.
requirements.rationale: The central owner-only access rule cannot be judged from the captured flow.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow authenticated users to navigate to a dedicated profile settings area.

claims.claim: Editable profile settings are accessible in an authenticated session.
claims.claim_text: Editable profile settings are accessible in an authenticated session.

claims.claim: Access to editable profile settings is limited to the authenticated account owner.
claims.claim_text: Access to editable profile settings is limited to the authenticated account owner.

requirements.evidence_note: The screenshots show profile access in a signed-in session, but they do not test another user, unauthenticated access, or authorization enforcement.

requirements.text: The system shall apply all saved profile dining preferences consistently to every future reservation made from the account.
requirements.rationale: The universal future-application requirement is not verifiable from these screenshots.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall let users maintain reusable dining preferences that can inform future reservations.

claims.claim: Profile dining preferences can be edited.
claims.claim_text: Profile dining preferences can be edited.

claims.claim: All saved profile dining preferences are applied consistently to every future reservation made from the account.
claims.claim_text: All saved profile dining preferences are applied consistently to every future reservation made from the account.

requirements.evidence_note: The flow shows profile dining preference editing, but no future reservations or consistency checks are shown.

requirements.text: The system shall present an explicit post-save confirmation or summary indicating that profile edits were stored.
requirements.rationale: Because the post-save condition is not exercised, the flow is insufficient for a reliable positive or negative decision.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall present existing profile information in editable, prepopulated form.

claims.claim: The system presents an explicit post-save confirmation after profile edits are saved.
claims.claim_text: The system presents an explicit post-save confirmation after profile edits are saved.

claims.claim: The post-save confirmation or summary indicates that profile edits were stored.
claims.claim_text: The post-save confirmation or summary indicates that profile edits were stored.

requirements.evidence_note: The final relevant screenshot shows edited profile values and a Save action, but it does not show a save attempt or post-save state.

requirements.text: The system shall warn users about unsaved profile changes before they leave the editing flow.
requirements.rationale: The warning condition is not exercised, so the requirement cannot be judged.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow users to add or edit a short personal bio in their profile.

claims.claim: Users can create unsaved profile changes.
claims.claim_text: Users can create unsaved profile changes.

claims.claim: The system warns users about unsaved profile changes before they leave the editing flow.
claims.claim_text: The system warns users about unsaved profile changes before they leave the editing flow.

requirements.evidence_note: The flow shows profile edits, but it does not show the user attempting to leave the editing flow before saving.
